title: lappa personata
intro: Lappa personata, commonly known as Khas or Bhotia, is a traditional plant used in Ayurvedic medicine, belonging to the family Compositae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Lappa personata include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoids and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine.
